title: testcases/cases.json: the testcase-writer's structured cases and cited exclusions, the only file it writes. scripts/testcases.mjs build gives each case its stable TC id (by key), derives @assumption and renders every downstream file from it.

key.description: The stable case key (a slug). Its TC id is assigned once and never changes; never rename a key.

title.description: A declarative name of the behavior, unique in the module.

api.description: The behavior is an API contract (the API side automates it).

assumption.description: The writer's own assumption; the script also sets @assumption itself.

assumes.description: What the case assumes (required with assumption: true).

action.description: The one When: declarative, no clicks or keys.

steps.description: Concrete steps a person can follow (named elements, example data).

expected.description: The one Then; the product's messages quoted verbatim in double quotes, found in the evidence.

covers.description: The coverage items (CI ids) the case covers; at least one.

evidence.description: What the case relies on: clarification:<id>, knowledge:<path>[#L<line>|#KQ-<id>], observation:<path>; at least one.

citation.description: What shows why; required for every reason except duplicate-of.

of.description: duplicate-of: the item that covers it.
